## Details

<a id="tune1_voice1"></a>
### [`tune1_voice1`](../../../../src/music/tune_data.asm#L6) `$6000-$6031`

*data*

Tune 1: $8236 starts it with voice 1 at $6000 and voice 2 at $6200, and waits until it ends.

<a id="tune2_voice1"></a>
### [`tune2_voice1`](../../../../src/music/tune_data.asm#L15) `$6032-$61FF`

*data*

Tune 2, voice 1: $825d starts it from $6032 when no tune plays. Voice 1 has no end marker. Voice 2 ends the tune.

<a id="tune1_voice2"></a>
### [`tune1_voice2`](../../../../src/music/tune_data.asm#L75) `$6200-$622D`

*data*

Notes of SID voice 2, read through the pointer $15/$16 at $8143. Same format as voice 1. Note $ff ends the tune: the player clears the tune flag $1a.

<a id="tune2_voice2"></a>
### [`tune2_voice2`](../../../../src/music/tune_data.asm#L83) `$622E-$63BF`

*data*

The pair at $622e is the end of tune 1 (note $ff). It is also the start address of tune 2, voice 2, which $825d sets.
